st-dorothys-rest.note: Research note: the retreats page lists per-building bed counts (Main House, Farmer, Lydia, Upper/Lower Miriam) and 2026 rates; 12-person minimum for meals; dorm bedding extra. Office hours Tue-Fri 10-5.

westerbeke-ranch.note: Research note: meeting rooms on site are Casa Nueva and the Round House; cabins are color-named. The venue's photo library is low resolution, hence the softer images here.

the-land.note: Research note: the site now also brands the property as 'The Eros Monastery' with practice-infused stays; it is 18+ only and alcohol- and cannabis-free. Verizon has no signal on site (AT&T and T-Mobile do).

camp-navarro.note: Research note: the physical address is 901 Masonite Industrial Rd, Navarro. Booking inquiries go to inquiry@campnavarroca.com; site tours are by approved request only.

enchanted-hills.note: Research note: now branded 'Enchanted Hills Napa'. Post-fire rebuild includes the Forest Commons dining/meeting hall, Hillside Village casitas, and Lakeside and Forest cabins plus tents and yurts.

saratoga-springs.note: Research note: the official site is a frozen 2020 page with tiny photos, so the gallery here is thin. The center is still operating (it hosted a festival in Oct 2025); site text says exclusive use for groups of 25+, 2-10 night stays, 260 acres.

ymca-point-bonita.name: NatureBridge Golden Gate
ymca-point-bonita.sleeps: Dorm lodging on two campuses (Bluff at Point Bonita, Beach at Fort Cronkhite); up to 200 guests total
ymca-point-bonita.meeting: 4 meeting rooms: Coast 20-49, Raven 30-62, Cypress 30-97, Sunset 50-130
ymca-point-bonita.buyout: Ask; with two campuses, 60 can likely have the Bluff campus to itself
ymca-point-bonita.watch: Bunk dorms and shared baths; institutional interiors. The YMCA no longer runs it: NatureBridge took over in Nov 2023, so the sheet's YMCA phone is stale
ymca-point-bonita.subtitle: former YMCA Point Bonita
ymca-point-bonita.note: Research note: the YMCA of SF closed this site; NatureBridge now markets it as the Golden Gate Conference & Retreat Center. Published 2026 rates are about $157-162 per person per night ($136-141 for nonprofits). Overnight availability is Fri-Sun during the school year, which fits Oct 16-18.

walker-creek-ranch.note: Research note: the conference-center contact on the site is (415) 491-6603 / jparker@marinschools.org (the sheet had the main office line). Lodging is four lodges with 2-5 bed rooms, 13 bunk cabins, two bunkhouses and camping.

harbin-hot-springs.note: Research note: the post-2015-fire rebuild is still in progress. A new restaurant opened in August 2026 and a new multi-story hotel is being finished; current lodging is domes, hotel rooms, caravans and tent camping. Harbin has not allowed group bookings since July 2023: every guest buys a membership and books individually, so a 60-person retreat here means 60 separate reservations.

1440-multiversity.note: Research note: 1440 never sells a buyout; groups book room blocks under all-inclusive packages, and its Group FAQ says it has a waiting list for private mission-aligned group events.

land-of-medicine-buddha.note: Research note: the sheet's stay.landofmedicinebuddha.org booking link was returning errors; the working group-rentals page is on the main domain.

hidden-villa.note: Research note: meeting spaces are the Dana Center, Duveneck House and Morgan Family Pavilion; the hostel sleeps 39.

ratna-ling.name: Ratna Ling
ratna-ling.why: Gorgeous Tibetan Buddhist retreat center in the coastal hills, but too small for 60. Noted so it does not come up again.

green-gulch-farm.name: Green Gulch Farm
green-gulch-farm.why: Zen Center farm in a coastal valley above Muir Beach. Gorgeous, but too small for 60, and not accepting new 2026 booking requests.

sea-ranch-lodge.name: Sea Ranch Lodge
sea-ranch-lodge.why: Iconic 1960s modernist lodge on the Sonoma coast bluffs. Gorgeous, but too small for 60. Noted so it does not come up again.

lodge-at-marconi.note: Research note: as of Aug 21 the hotel booking engine returns no rooms for any night Oct 1-29 (while late October onward is wide open), which looks like a closure or full buyout; the reason is not published, so ask.
